hero.description: Explore every federal and state in Malaysian history. See which parties won the election, check out the popular vote, and delve into statistics on voter turnout and undi rosak.

header_1: Explore any election from Merdeka to the present!
explore:
This page is designed to help you explore the results for a particular election, such as the 15th General Election in 2022. 
If you wish to explore the full history for a particular candidate or party, visit our Party and Candidate Explorer instead!
